  WHY: While the parent directory created by `mktemp -d` is typically 0700, setting 0755 on the `socket` subdirectory is unnecessarily permissive and relies on parent permissions for security. No diff hunk in orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml replaces any danger-full-access invocation with the isolated container path; the three codex call sites (approximately lines 767, 836, 852) still process issue-opener-controlled text with full host credentials.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- scripts/clarify_isolated_run.sh: line 31 — mkdir -m 0755 "${run_root}/socket"
  PROBLEM: Broker socket directory is world-traversable (0755) even though the parent run_root from mktemp -d is 0700. The 0700 parent already protects against cross-user access on standard GitHub-hosted runners, but a non-default umask or shared self-hosted runner setup could expose the directory tree to other host users, who could then connect to the broker socket and proxy requests with OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
  WHY: Suggested minimal fix: Change to mkdir -m 0700 for the socket directory only (source and results are mounted readonly into the container, so their permissions don't matter for security).
- scripts/clarify_openrouter_broker.py: line 128 — os.chmod(sys.argv[2], 0o666)
  PROBLEM: Broker socket file is world-readable/writable (0666). Combined with the 0755 parent, any local process that can traverse the parent directory can connect.
  WHY: The 0700 on run_root currently prevents this, but tightening the socket to 0600 matches the same defense-in-depth rationale.
- scripts/clarify_openrouter_broker.py: lines 19-21 — class UnixHTTPServer(socketserver.UnixStreamServer): allow_reuse_address = True
  PROBLEM: allow_reuse_address is a TCP-only flag (sets SO_REUSEADDR). It is meaningless for UnixStreamServer and the class has no inherited TCP behavior that would honor it.
  WHY: Dead code that could mislead future maintainers into thinking the socket can be rebound while in use.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

- scripts/clarify_isolated_run.sh: line 31, `mkdir -m 0755 "${run_root}/socket" "${run_root}/source" "${run_root}/results"` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The broker socket directory is created with mode 0755 (world-traversable), while the broker socket itself is chmod 0o666 (scripts/clarify_openrouter_broker.py:128). The comment in broker.py states "Parent directory is run-private on the host," which relies on mktemp -d creating a 0700 parent.
  WHY: On a standard GitHub Actions runner this is safe, but if the runner's umask or TMPDIR permissions change, the 0755 socket directory becomes traversable by other users on shared runners, who could then connect to the broker socket and proxy requests using the host's OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Tightening the socket directory to 0700 eliminates this dependency and matches the stated intent.
